failure_modes: Combinations that are incoherent when sampled independently
gloss: Use ordinary code to inject randomness so the model does not loop
invariants: Variety is produced outside the model by deterministic or seeded sampling
Each dimension is independent so combinations multiply
mechanism: Rather than asking a model to be creative, external code rolls dice over several independent scenario dimensions (who, mood, situation, circumstance) and hands the sampled combination to the model as a fixed script. Combinatorial variety comes from the code, and the model only performs the resulting scene.
